# Serialization Errors and Warnings

Messages about the serialization of aspects and of the objects they reference, with [PSerializable] and the serializers of PostSharp.

| Message | Severity | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <xref:sr0001?text=SR0001> | Error | The [PSerializable] attribute is added to an interface. |
| <xref:sr0002?text=SR0002> | Error | A [PSerializable] class derives from a class that has no deserializing constructor. |
| <xref:sr0003?text=SR0003> | Error | The base constructor that the deserializing constructor of a serializable type must call is not accessible. |
| <xref:sr0004?text=SR0004> | Error | A serializable type has a read-only field that must be serialized. |
| <xref:sr0005?text=SR0005> | Error | A serializable type defines the deserializing constructor that PostSharp generates. |
| <xref:sr0006?text=SR0006> | Error | A serializable type derives from a type that has no serializer. |
| <xref:sr0007?text=SR0007> | Error | A serializable type derives from a type whose serializer has not been generated, because its assembly was built without PostSharp. |
| <xref:sr0008?text=SR0008> | Error | The serializer of the base type of a [PSerializable] class does not derive from ReferenceTypeSerializer. |
| <xref:sr0009?text=SR0009> | Error | The serializer of the base type of a [PSerializable] class is not visible from this class. |
| <xref:sr0010?text=SR0010> | Error | The serializer of the base type of a [PSerializable] class has no default constructor. |
| <xref:sr0011?text=SR0011> | Error | The default constructor of the serializer of the base type of a [PSerializable] class is not accessible. |
| <xref:sr0012?text=SR0012> | Error | The serializer of the base type of a [PSerializable] class seals a method that the generated serializer overrides. |
| <xref:sr0013?text=SR0013> | Error | The custom serializer of the base type of a [PSerializable] type is sealed. |
| <xref:sr0016?text=SR0016> | Error | A [PSerializable] type already contains a nested type named Serializer. |
